PARAM_C(PARAM_C_ID, "-c", "Coverage threshold", "List matches above this fraction of aligned (covered) residues (see --cov-mode)", typeid(float), (void *) &covThr, "^0(\.[0-9]+)?|^1(\.0+)?$", MMseqsParameter::COMMAND_ALIGN | MMseqsParameter::COMMAND_CLUSTLINEAR),
        PARAM_COV_MODE(PARAM_COV_MODE_ID, "--cov-mode", "Coverage mode", "0: coverage of query and target
1: coverage of target
2: coverage of query
3: target seq. length has to be at least x% of query length
4: query seq. length has to be at least x% of target length
5: short seq. needs to be at least x% of the other seq. length", typeid(int), (void *) &covMode, "^[0-5]{1}$", MMseqsParameter::COMMAND_ALIGN),
limitation: Parameter definition only; no MMseqs execution or cluster benchmark
